name: ask-install-python
label: Install Python 3?
description: Asks the person whether to install Python 3, only when it is missing.

exe_data.detail: It doesn't appear to be installed on your computer. Would you like to install it now?

commands.darwin: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; for c in python3 python; do p="$(command -v $c 2>/dev/null)" || continue; if [ "$p" = /usr/bin/python3 ] || [ "$p" = /usr/bin/python ]; then d="$(xcode-select -p 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$d" ] && [ -x "$d/usr/bin/$c" ] || continue; fi; v=$($c --version 2>&1) && case "$v" in "Python 3"*) echo '{}'; exit 0;; esac; done; exit 1
commands.linux: for c in python3 python; do v=$($c --version 2>&1) && case "$v" in "Python 3"*) echo '{}'; exit 0;; esac; done; exit 1
commands.win32: $env:Path += ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); foreach ($c in @('py','python')) { if (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $a = @(); if ($c -eq 'py') { $a = @('-3') }; $v = & $c @a --version 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and [string]$v -match '^Python 3') { '{}'; exit 0 } } }; exit 1
